description: Create Cognito groups (patient, physio) in Pool A and backfill existing users. This is a prerequisite for backend role checks and auto-assignment on signup.
steps: Run AWS CLI to create 'patient' group in Pool A (ap-south-1_AulfstD9s): aws cognito-idp create-group --profile moovv-fit-ujwal-admin --user-pool-id ap-south-1_AulfstD9s --group-name patient --description 'App users - patients'
Run AWS CLI to create 'physio' group in Pool A: aws cognito-idp create-group --profile moovv-fit-ujwal-admin --user-pool-id ap-south-1_AulfstD9s --group-name physio --description 'Physiotherapists'

Create backfill script at /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/scripts/backfill-cognito-groups.ts that: (a) lists all Cognito users via AdminListUsersCommand, (b) queries physio_profile table to identify physios by userId, (c) adds all users to 'patient' group, (d) adds physio users to 'physio' group
Run the backfill script with: cd /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node && npx tsx scripts/backfill-cognito-groups.ts
Update /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-landing/.agents/specs/unified-auth/tasks.md to mark TASK-1.1, TASK-1.2, TASK-1.3 as complete with [x]
acceptance_criteria: aws cognito-idp list-groups --profile moovv-fit-ujwal-admin --user-pool-id ap-south-1_AulfstD9s shows both 'patient' and 'physio' groups
Spot-check 3 random users with admin-list-groups-for-user shows 'patient' group
Spot-check a known physio user shows both 'patient' and 'physio' groups
verification: aws cognito-idp list-groups --profile moovv-fit-ujwal-admin --user-pool-id ap-south-1_AulfstD9s --query 'Groups[].GroupName' --output text | grep -E 'patient.*physio|physio.*patient'
findings: Created patient and physio groups in Pool A (ap-south-1_AulfstD9s). Backfilled 38 users to patient group. Physio group backfill requires DB access - script created at scripts/backfill-cognito-groups.ts that will add physios when run with proper DB credentials. Spot-checked 3 users, all show patient group membership.
